tooltip.jestertricks.jester_scepter.1: Right-click: a storm of black petals that dizzies and blinds (7 blocks).
tooltip.jestertricks.sharp_cards.1: Sneaking: a single ace with much more damage.
tooltip.jestertricks.juggler_knives.0: Throws a knife that flies back to your hand.
tooltip.jestertricks.juggler_knives.1: Passes through walls on its way back.
tooltip.jestertricks.rubber_mallet.1: Right-click: ground pound that launches everything within 5 blocks.
tooltip.jestertricks.bang_pistol.1: They explode: 4 hearts that ignore armor and never kill.
tooltip.jestertricks.magic_top_hat.1: A rabbit, a gift... or bats.
tooltip.jestertricks.magic_wand.0: Right-click: swap places with the creature you look at.
tooltip.jestertricks.magic_wand.1: Sneaking: teleport to where you look.
tooltip.jestertricks.smoke_bomb.0: Poof! Invisibility and speed for 10 s.
tooltip.jestertricks.smoke_bomb.1: Blinds everything nearby and they lose track of you.
tooltip.jestertricks.endless_scarves.0: Grapple: pulls you to the block or drags creatures in.
tooltip.jestertricks.squirting_flower.1: Water jet: pushes, puts out fire and hurts Endermen and Blazes.
tooltip.jestertricks.surprise_box.0: Step on it or open it... if you dare.
tooltip.jestertricks.whoopee_cushion.1: Whoever steps on it gets dizzy. PFFT!
tooltip.jestertricks.origin_star.0: A piece of the world the Jester came from.
tooltip.jestertricks.origin_star.1: Right-click: open a rift to another dimension. Sneak: choose destination.
tooltip.jestertricks.fair_hoop.0: Sneak + click the ground: place the fixed hoop.
tooltip.jestertricks.fair_hoop.1: Click the ground: place a temporary hoop.
tooltip.jestertricks.fair_hoop.2: Jump through a temporary one to arrive at the fixed one.
tooltip.jestertricks.black_box.1: Sneak on a creature: swallow it. Sneak on the ground: release it.
tooltip.jestertricks.black_box.2: Sneak on a player: send them to the pocket dimension for 1 minute.
tooltip.jestertricks.fate_deck.0: On another player or creature: a bad card.
tooltip.jestertricks.fate_deck.1: In the air: a good card for you.
tooltip.jestertricks.laugh_mirror.0: Three copies of you step out of the mirror.
message.jestertricks.not_jester: Only the Jester knows how to use this...
message.jestertricks.anchor_set: Fixed hoop placed. Every hoop will lead here.
message.jestertricks.no_anchor: No fixed hoop yet. Place one while sneaking.
message.jestertricks.box_cannot: The box can't swallow that (or it's already full).
message.jestertricks.card_received: The Jester dealt you a card: %s
tooltip.jestertricks.juggling_pins.0: Throws 3 pins that bounce from enemy to enemy.
tooltip.jestertricks.juggling_pins.1: Each pin hits up to 3 times.
tooltip.jestertricks.clown_balloon.0: On a creature or player: ties a balloon that lifts it.
tooltip.jestertricks.clown_balloon.1: In the air: tie it to yourself. When it pops, you float down.
tooltip.jestertricks.circus_cannon.0: Right-click: get launched where you look.
death.attack.jestertricks.juggling_pin.p: %1$s was knocked down like a pin by %2$s
death.attack.jestertricks.juggling_pin.i: %1$s was knocked down like a pin by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.jestertricks.cream_pie: %1$s got a pie in the face
death.attack.jestertricks.cream_pie.play: %1$s got a pie in the face from %2$s
death.attack.jestertricks.cream_pie.item: %1$s got a pie in the face from %2$s
death.attack.jestertricks.mallet: %1$s went BOING! for the last time
death.attack.jestertricks.mallet.player: %1$s went BOING! for the last time thanks to %2$s
death.attack.jestertricks.mallet.item: %1$s went BOING! for the last time thanks to %2$s
screen.jestertricks.passives.sub: Turn your jester perks on or off
screen.jestertricks.passive.no_fall.desc: You always land on your feet, with confetti.
screen.jestertricks.passive.night_vision: See in the dark, like in your home world.
screen.jestertricks.passive.kill_laugh.d: Laugh and burst into starry confetti when you defeat something.
commands.jestertricks.not_found: %s was not on the Jester list.
commands.jestertricks.list_empty: There is no Jester: anyone can use the items.
commands.jestertricks.cleared: Jester list cleared: anyone can use the items now.
commands.jestertricks.you_are_jester: You hear distant laughter... You are now the Jester.
message.jestertricks.pocket_swallowed: The Black Box swallowed you... Everything the Jester keeps is watching.
message.jestertricks.pocket_sent: %s is inside the Black Box (%s s)
message.jestertricks.pocket_released: The box opens and you return to the light.
tooltip.jestertricks.black_box.3: Sneak in the air: enter or leave your pocket.
tooltip.jestertricks.black_box.4: Inside, click a player: let them out.
tooltip.jestertricks.doll_box.0: Right-click: 3 harlequin dolls pop out to follow you and fight for you.
tooltip.jestertricks.doll_box.1: Sneak + right-click: they go back in the box.
message.jestertricks.dolls_back: The dolls go back in the box.
tooltip.jestertricks.laugh_mask.0: Right click: a cackle that sends monsters fleeing and weakens everyone.
tooltip.jestertricks.confetti_bag.0: Right click: a confetti storm that blinds and slows those around you.
tooltip.jestertricks.confetti_bag.1: It never empties. Nobody knows what's at the bottom.
tooltip.jestertricks.shadow_cloak.0: Right click: 3 s invisible and fast; hits pass through you.
tooltip.jestertricks.cracked_mask.0: Right click: 10 s in your true form. Monsters flee, sight darkens.
tooltip.jestertricks.cracked_mask.1: Through the crack you can see what lies beneath.
